notes.title: Dalruan Online is here!
notes.content:
We have completely Re-Made the game for 4 Player Online Experience!

Welcome to the Dalruan Online!

An Adventure of Realms and Monsters. 
Single Player or with up to 4 players in Epic Online Co-op!
Gather Elemental Ore and Protect the realm from the Darkness and his Evil Servants - The Elemental Dragons!

Choose between a Male or Female Protagonist.
Action Combat.
Collect Herbs, Key Items and Quest Items.
Mine many Different types of Ore and Merge them into Stronger Variations.
Craft different Weapons, Helmets, Armor, Shields and Rings.
Select from 8 Different Elements (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Poison, Dark, Undead and Holy).
Epic boss battles. Navigate horrid caves, dungeons and ruins in Single Player or With Friends!

Join the ever advancing Realm of Dalruan.

notes.title: Dalruan Officially Released 09/14/2021
notes.content:
The day has come!

Dalruan has been Launched!

I really hope you all enjoy the game! 

Depending on how well this release goes, Future updates are currently being planned.

- New Dungeons/Areas/Zones
- New Quests
- New Items (Beyond Legendary Crafting)
- New Monsters
- New Bosses
- Expanded Professions (Mining/Fishing/Herbalism)
- Additions to the Ever growing World of Dalruan.

If it does really well, my dream is to be able to add Multiplayer in a future update or sequel.

I am a one man team,
Thank you for your support and thank you for joining me on this Adventure.
- JxRannok

notes.title: Dalruan Release Date 09/14/2021
notes.content:
I am very happy to announce the Release of my First Game on Steam
Dalruan - World of Magic!

Release date: 09/14/2021

Dalruan is a Full RPG game that should take many many hours to complete.

I hope all of you enjoy my RPG and help save Dalruan and the Elemental Orbs from the clutches of Sargoth!

I have recently added Fishing as a Small addition to the game and will be giving more updates on future quests and additions to the game.

I will be adding an AMA section and will be answering your questions as soon as possible.

Also, let me know,
Which Element will you pick?
Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Poison, Dark, Undead or Holy?

Thanks!
- JxRannok
